variant.title: Prime Sudoku
variant.description: Cells marked with P may contain only prime digits: 2, 3, 5 or 7.
rule.prime: Cells marked with P may contain only prime digits: 2, 3, 5 or 7.
rule_guide.title: Prime Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Cells marked with P may contain only prime digits.
rule_guide.item_2: The prime digits in this rule are 2, 3, 5 and 7.
rule_guide.item_3: Unmarked cells have no extra Prime rule restriction and follow normal Sudoku rules.
